note: condensed from the Higgsfield result by Claude; visuals shortened, audio lines verbatim

scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: A medium-tempo electronic pop beat with a high-pitched, playful vocal sample saying 'Yummy' repeatedly.
scenes.visual: female hands hold matte pink case, right hand lifts the lid: two white cat-face earbuds with pink bows; pink bedroom with plush toys, string lights

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: The rhythmic electronic beat continues with upbeat synth pulses.
scenes.visual: single earbud balanced on the tip of the index finger, static; white cat face, pink bow, grey silicone tip; pink couch, bedside lamp

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: The vocal sample 'Yummy' repeats in sync with the beat.
scenes.visual: young blonde woman, ponytail, freckles, chunky pink sweater; side profile; inserts the earbud into her RIGHT ear with her right hand

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: A short transition sound effect, like a high-pitched chime, over the music.
scenes.visual: tight shot of the ear with the earbud fully inserted; two small gold studs in the earlobe

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: The music continues at a steady volume with the 'Yummy' vocal sample.
scenes.visual: she sits on a pink bed against a faux-fur pillow under a fuzzy blanket, sips from a white mug with both hands, eyes closed

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: The music fades out with a final beat.
scenes.visual: final static shot identical to scene 4, earbud in the ear
